intro_logo_blocks.desc: Logo intro score (25.5 s, 120 BPM, D hijaz): darbuka, qanun, marimba block landings, risers and the final sting. Synced to remotion/src/intro/cues.json.

intro_stitch.desc: Stitch intro score (4.5 s, 120 BPM, D hijaz): needle whoosh, spinning whirr and qanun run, a zip per stitch, marimba line drawing, knot hit with bell chord and darbuka, fly-out whoosh. Synced to remotion/src/intro/stitch.json.

intro_spin.desc: Paper-cut spin intro score (5 s, 120 BPM, D hijaz): knife slices, paper pop, spinning whirr with darbuka and qanun, slide whistle, three ring landings, logo rise hit with bell chord, typing taps. Synced to remotion/src/intro/spin.json.
